video_title: Windy Explains Why The Clippers NEED To Accept This Punishment

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Why the Clippers should accept the NBA's penalty
quotes.excerpt: Accept the penalty and ask for one provision that no more penalties are levied.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Here is my unsolicited advice to the Clippers organization: accept the penalty and ask for one provision that no more penalties are levied.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: I would say cut your losses would be wise.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Clippers and Raptors can still proceed with the trade
quotes.excerpt: They can bring the trade to the league to get it done. They basically said go through the process.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: If they are allowed to do this trade, which I checked on this and basically I was told they can, the Raptors and Clippers if they want can bring the trade to the league to get it done. They basically said go through the process. They didn't say no.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard is free to be traded
quotes.excerpt: Kawhi is free to be traded with a clean slate.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Kawhi is free to be traded with a clean slate. And they are going to get two first-round picks for him.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: And by the way, the two first-round picks, those are the only two first-round picks they own that don't have swap rights attached to them now.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Clippers should plead guilty to avoid further penalties
quotes.excerpt: If they could plead guilty, get an agreement and say we're not going to challenge any of these penalties.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: If they could plead guilty, get an agreement and say we're not going to challenge any of these penalties, and they get an agreement that there will be no further penalties, basically they'll say that these five first-round picks are all-encompassing, they cover everything, it's a blanket agreement, and they keep their nose clean, they might be able to come out of this without four broken limbs.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: If they don't want to get their limbs broken, they need to stop throwing rocks at the league office.
